slides.hook: stuck on the same weight for weeks?

slides.title: rule 1
slides.text: pick a load you can do for at least 4 clean reps.

slides.title: rule 2
slides.text: keep that load. add reps over time.

slides.title: rule 3
slides.text: own 8 clean reps with full range? now add load.

slides.title: rule 4
slides.text: the new load should bring you back to 4–5 reps. build to 8 again.

slides.title: the catch
slides.text: if adding weight breaks your form, you haven't earned the increase.

slides.label: real tip
slides.text: you can't beat last session if you don't know it. log every working set.
